Dana: Quick heads-up: a user-reported spike of 429s during the onboarding scroll demo this morning.
Dana: Demo kicks off aggressive prefetch (next 8 cursors) + two embed calls per item.
Dana: Sample response: 429 Too Many Requests, Retry-After: 4, X-RI-Quota: 1/60, X-RI-Reset: 76
Priya (sdk): Which SDKs? We recently increased prefetch for python v1.6.x in hopes of smoother UX.
Dana: Backend uses python-sdk v1.6.4, web uses js-sdk v1.4.2.
Omar (infra): Logs show concurrent auth refresh attempts for the same credential id right before the quota hit. Classic retry stampede.
Lee (oncall): Symptoms: multiple threads detect expired token -> parallel refresh -> everybody retries and consumes remaining quota. 
Priya (sdk): Parity issue: JS coalesces refresh; python async prefetch path doesn't. I'll ship a hotfix to add per-credential refresh coalescing (mutex) and make the SDK honor Retry-After before retrying. Also propose default prefetch for trial installs = 2.
Priya (sdk): Patch pseudocode:
```
lock = get_lock(cred_id)
with lock:
  if token_expired():
    refresh_token()
# On 429
retry_after = int(resp.headers.get('Retry-After', 0))
sleep(max(base_backoff * 2**attempt, retry_after))
```
Omar (infra): We can also add client-facing quota hints: SDK should parse X-RI-Quota and flip to conservative mode when remaining <= 3 (disable background prefetch + concurrency=1). I'll enable a short smoothing bucket on the edge for UI traffic while patch rolls out.
Dana: Immediate mitigation: set PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY=1 in the sample env (done) and redeploy to staging.
deploy-bot: deploy-staging succeeded for sample-onboard @ 2025-08-12T10:14:02Z
Lee (oncall): Tasks: - Priya: PR for auth dedupe + prefetch default change (ETA 5h) - Omar: edge smoothing for trial bucket (ETA 1.5h) - Dana: sample env flip + comms (done) - Lee: incident note + followup (ETA 3h)
Priya (sdk): I'll also add a dev-mode warning when X-RI-Quota is low so integrators see it during onboarding. Will include unit+integration tests for concurrent refresh + low-quota 429 handling.
Dana: Good. Also consider recommending idempotency keys for prefetch calls to avoid double-counting if retries succeed after the original.
Omar (infra): Agreed. We can support idempotency tokens on the prefetch route as a longer term improvement.
Lee (oncall): Closing loop: ping here if residual 429s after patches roll out. Thanks all.
